# Game Idea: Neon Escape

**Genre:** Arcade / Endless Runner
**Platform:** HTML Canvas

**Concept**
- The player pilots a small ship navigating an endless, scrolling neon tunnel.
- Obstacles appear as glowing barriers that must be dodged.
- Controls: left/right arrow keys to steer, spacebar for a short boost.

**Goal**
- Survive as long as possible while the tunnel speeds up.
- Score accumulates by distance traveled.

**Lose condition**
- Collision with an obstacle.
- Running out of boost energy.

1: // Neon Escape – simple endless runner on canvas#game
2: 
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
6: canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
7: 
8: // Starfield setup
9: const STAR_COUNT = 120;
10: const stars = [];
11: for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
12:   stars.push({
13:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
14:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
15:     size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
16:     speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.7,
17:     hue: 200 + Math.random() * 60,
18:   });
19: }
20: 
21: function updateStars() {
22:   // Move stars toward the viewer to create motion illusion
23:   stars.forEach(s => {
24:     s.y += s.speed * speed * 0.5; // tie to tunnel speed
25:     if (s.y > canvas.height) {
26:       s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
27:       s.y = -s.size;
28:       s.size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
29:       s.speed = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.7;
30:       s.hue = 200 + Math.random() * 60;
31:     }
32:   });
33: }
34: 
35: function drawStars() {
36:   stars.forEach(s => {
37:     ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${s.hue},80%,80%)`;
38:     ctx.beginPath();
39:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
40:     ctx.fill();
41:   });
42: }
43: 
44: 
45: // Player ship
46: const player = {
47:   x: canvas.width / 2,
48:   y: canvas.height * 0.8,
49:   w: 30,
50:   h: 40,
51:   speed: 5,
52:   boostSpeed: 10,
53:   boostEnergy: 100, // max 100
54:   boosting: false,
55: };
56: 
57: // Obstacles
58: const obstacles = [];
59: let obstacleTimer = 0;
60: const obstacleInterval = 90; // frames
61: 
62: let distance = 0;
63: let speed = 2; // tunnel scroll speed
64: let gameOver = false;
65: 
66: // Input handling
67: const keys = {};
68: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); });
69: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
70: 
71: function spawnObstacle() {
72:   const size = 40 + Math.random() * 30;
73:   const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
74:   obstacles.push({ x, y: -size, w: size, h: size });
75: }
76: 
77: // Audio setup
78: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
79: let boostPlaying = false;
80: function playBoost() {
81:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
82:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
83:   osc.frequency.value = 600;
84:   osc.type = 'sawtooth';
85:   osc.connect(gain);
86:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
87:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
88:   osc.start();
89:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
90: }
91: function playCrash() {
92:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
93:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
94:   osc.frequency.value = 150;
95:   osc.type = 'triangle';
96:   osc.connect(gain);
97:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
98:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
99:   osc.start();
100:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
101: }
102: 
103: function update() {
104:   if (gameOver) return;
105: 
106:   // Player movement
107:   if (keys['ArrowLeft']) player.x -= player.speed;
108:   if (keys['ArrowRight']) player.x += player.speed;
109: 
110:   // Boost handling
111:   if (keys['Space'] && player.boostEnergy > 0) { if (!player.boosting) playBoost();
112:     player.boosting = true;
113:     player.y -= player.boostSpeed;
114:     player.boostEnergy -= 2;
115:   } else {
116:     player.boosting = false;
117:     player.y += player.speed; // natural descent
118:     if (player.boostEnergy < 100) player.boostEnergy += 1; // regen
119:   }
120: 
121:   // Keep player inside canvas
122:   if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
123:   if (player.x + player.w > canvas.width) player.x = canvas.width - player.w;
124:   if (player.y < 0) player.y = 0;
125:   if (player.y + player.h > canvas.height) player.y = canvas.height - player.h;
126: 
127:   // Update starfield positions for motion effect
128:   updateStars();
129: 
130:   // Obstacle logic
131:   obstacleTimer++;
132:   if (obstacleTimer >= obstacleInterval) {
133:     spawnObstacle();
134:     obstacleTimer = 0;
135:     // Gradually increase tunnel speed
136:     speed += 0.02;
137:   }
138: 
139:   obstacles.forEach(o => o.y += speed);
140:   // Remove off‑screen obstacles
141:   while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].y > canvas.height) obstacles.shift();
142: 
143:   // Collision detection
144:   for (const o of obstacles) {
145:     if (
146:       player.x < o.x + o.w &&
147:       player.x + player.w > o.x &&
148:       player.y < o.y + o.h &&
149:       player.y + player.h > o.y
150:     ) {
151:       gameOver = true;
152:       playCrash();
153:     }
154:   }
155: 
156:   distance += speed;
157: }
158: 
159: function draw() {
160:   // Clear with neon background
161:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000020';
162:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
163: 
164:   // Draw animated starfield
165:   drawStars();
166: 
167:   // Draw obstacles with neon glow
168:   drawObstacles();
169: 
170:   // Draw player ship with glow effect
171:   drawShip();
172: 
173:   // UI – score & boost
174:   ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
175:   ctx.font = '20px monospace';
176:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(distance)}`, 20, 30);
177:   ctx.fillText(`Boost: ${Math.floor(player.boostEnergy)}`, 20, 60);
178: 
179:   if (gameOver) {
180:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,0,0,0.7)';
181:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
182:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
183:     ctx.font = '48px monospace';
184:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 120, canvas.height / 2);
185:   }
186: }
187: 
188: function drawShip() {
189:   ctx.save();
190:   // Glow effect varies with boost
191:   ctx.shadowColor = player.boosting ? '#00ff80' : '#00ffff';
192:   ctx.shadowBlur = player.boosting ? 20 : 12;
193: 
194:   // Ship shape – triangle pointing up
195:   ctx.fillStyle = player.boosting ? '#00ff80' : '#00ffff';
196:   ctx.beginPath();
197:   ctx.moveTo(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y);
198:   ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + player.h);
199:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
200:   ctx.closePath();
201:   ctx.fill();
202:   ctx.restore();
203: }
204: 
205: function drawObstacles() {
206:   ctx.save();
207:   obstacles.forEach(o => {
208:     // Neon gradient for each obstacle
209:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x, o.y + o.h);
210:     grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,0,255,0.8)');
211:     grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,0,150,0.2)');
212:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
213:     ctx.shadowColor = '#ff00ff';
214:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
215:     ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
216:   });
217:   ctx.restore();
218: }
219: }
220: 
221: function loop() {
222:   update();
223:   draw();
224:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
225: }
226: 
227: loop();
